claim: The one-click demo loads three realistic sessions, saves nothing, and never changes real planner data.
where: home first screen, demo banner, README
sandbox: fresh browser context; create one real session, enter demo, change and reset sample data, then return to unchanged real data

claim: The recommendation reserves time for due reviews before allowing new cards.
sandbox: fresh demo; set one minute and 9,999 due reviews; assert a zero limit and reason

claim: The recommendation lowers the new-card limit when cards are harder.
sandbox: fresh demo with no due reviews; compare easy and hard outputs

claim: The planner shows a cautious limit, likely range, expected time, and assumptions.
sandbox: fresh demo; use 30 minutes, no reviews, and 60 seconds per new card; assert limit 26 and range 26–35

claim: The estimate uses useful session history after two logs and ignores logs with unlikely new-card times.
sandbox: fresh demo; keep two useful samples, add one unlikely sample, and assert learning status with only two useful sessions

claim: Real planner settings and sessions remain after a reload in the same browser.
sandbox: fresh demo context; start for real, save settings and a session, then reload

claim: The planner imports its documented session CSV format.
sandbox: fresh demo; import one valid session row and assert the populated history

claim: The planner groups supported Anki-style review rows into daily sessions.
sandbox: fresh demo; import three Anki-style rows across two dates and assert both sessions

claim: CSV export contains its header and one row per session.
sandbox: fresh demo with three sessions; download and inspect the CSV

claim: JSON backup contains the complete planner settings and session history.
sandbox: fresh demo; download and parse the JSON backup

claim: The planner restores settings and session history from its JSON backup format.
sandbox: fresh demo; import a valid backup and assert the restored setting and session

claim: The CSV template download contains the documented columns and one valid example row.
sandbox: fresh demo; download the template and inspect its header and example row

claim: The site provides a standalone PWA manifest and install icons.
sandbox: fresh demo; verify service-worker control, manifest fields, MIME type, and all declared icons

claim: The complete demo reloads offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load demo, clear HTTP cache, go offline, reload, and assert sample output with no failed shell assets

claim: The planner is free and requires no account, payment, or sign-in.
sandbox: fresh demo; assert free fact and absence of payment, registration, password, or sign-in paths

claim: Entered and imported study data is not sent off the product origin.
sandbox: fresh demo; capture every request while editing and importing private fixture data; assert same-origin only and no real planner database

claim: The app loads no analytics, ads, tracking pixels, third-party scripts, or remote fonts.
sandbox: fresh privacy route; capture requests and loaded resources; assert same-origin only

claim: Erase local data deletes real settings and study history from IndexedDB.
sandbox: fresh demo context; start for real, save data, erase it, and assert defaults, empty history, and deleted database

claim: The planner does not connect to or change Anki or FSRS.
sandbox: fresh demo; capture requests while changing planner inputs and assert same-origin only
